decision: 2026-09-19 user direction: numbers are introduced with the numeral itself, never with counted objects. These counting photos stay byte-for-byte and may be bound again only by a lesson that comes after the learner has been taught both the number word and the counted object's noun.
history: PR #148 (2026-09-12) wrote these pixels in place over the numeral-card photos that Lessons 2.6, 3.3 and 3.4 were built around, and copied each one to its *_four-card name without reframing it, so the four-card grid cropped the counts. The numeral cards were restored as a1_photo_number_card_NN_v1.webp.
reuse_requirements: The binding lesson must come at or after the lesson that declares the noun in its vocabulary.
The binding lesson must come at or after Lesson 2.6, which teaches the number words one to ten.
A four-card use needs a real reframe first: every *_four-card copy here is the same pixels as its 3:2 photo.
